description:
Use this when the user wants the text for a post written: "write my captions", "caption this for TikTok and
        Shorts", "give me a YouTube title and hashtags". clip_id: from list_clips. platforms: up to 5 of tiktok, youtube, instagram, facebook,
        threads, x, bluesky (Shorts, Reels, IG work too). tone: optional ("funny", "hype", "calm"). RipClip's caption
        writer works from the clip (its title, post text and hashtags), then each caption is cut to the platform's
        rules: TikTok 2,200 characters, Instagram 2,200 and at most 5 hashtags, YouTube a title of 100 characters (the
        first line) plus a description under 5,000 bytes, Threads 500, X 280.
        Not for: the subtitles shown inside the video (edit_clip, style_clip, translate_captions) or saving a post
        (draft_post). Saves nothing: show the captions, then draft_post saves the chosen one as a draft or update_draft
        changes an existing draft. If the writer is unavailable it says so. Free.
name: write_captions
title: Write captions
